name: cyclin E1
pathways: G1/S transition of mitotic cell cycle

function.text: CCNE1 encodes G1/S-specific cyclin-E1. Annotated molecular activities include cyclin-dependent protein serine/threonine kinase regulator activity. It participates in protein phosphorylation and G1/S transition of mitotic cell cycle.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Gastric adenocarcinoma; Adrenocortical carcinoma; Esophageal adenocarcinoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
